portInfo.description: Arctic port town in eastern Finnmark near the Russian border. Confirm Dypvannskaia berth assignment before planning a centre walk; museum visits and king crab experiences depend on opening hours, tickets, and what operators offer on your call day.

climate.description: Subarctic climate with cold winters and cool summers
